events.title: LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries to Augment Oncology Care
events.speaker: Manuel Fanarjian, MD
roles: Director of Clinical Informatics, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute
events.bio: Manuel Fanarjian is a palliative care physician and the Director of Clinical Informatics at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute. Prior to a career in medicine, he was a biomedical engineer, and has industry experience in medical devices and digital health technologies. He is a graduate of Duke University and UNC School of Medicine and did his post-graduate training at the University of Pennsylvania (Internal Medicine) and Massachusetts General Hospital/Brigham & Women's Hospital (Hospice and Palliative Medicine). He additionally completed a Biodesign fellowship at Harvard Medical School, and he has a deep interest in adapting systems of care delivery in ways that improve the experience of patients and families, as well as the clinicians and staff who serve them.
events.bio_short: Dr. Fanarjian is a palliative care physician and former biomedical engineer with industry experience in medical devices and digital health. A graduate of Duke and UNC School of Medicine, he trained in Internal Medicine at Penn and in Hospice and Palliative Medicine at MGH/Brigham, and completed a Biodesign fellowship at Harvard Medical School.
